info.title: Reml CLI
info.description: Command-line tool for REML: validate, format, parse, encode, and decode configuration files.

commands.name: decode
commands.description: Decode binary snapshot to REML text (stdout)

commands.name: emit
commands.description: Emit evaluated config as REML text snapshot

commands.name: encode
commands.description: Encode evaluated config as REML binary

commands.name: parse
commands.description: Parse and print config as JSON

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate file, print errors if any
